# Frisco Mini Molars

> > A kid-friendly pediatric dental practice in Frisco, TX led by Dr. Laura Mitchell, offering comprehensive dental services including emergency care, sedation dentistry, and specialized treatments for children.

Frisco Mini Molars is a pediatric dentistry practice specializing in gentle, compassionate dental care for children from infancy through adolescence. The practice emphasizes patient education, anxiety-free visits, and follows American Academy of Pediatric Dentistry guidelines.

## Core Services

- [Our Services](https://www.friscominimolars.com/services): Overview of all pediatric dental services offered by Frisco Mini Molars
- [Pediatric Dentistry Frisco](https://www.friscominimolars.com/pediatric-dentistry): Pediatric dentistry services and gentle care philosophy at Frisco Mini Molars
- [Emergency Dentistry Frisco](https://www.friscominimolars.com/emergency-dentistry): Fast, compassionate emergency dental care for children in Frisco
- [Oral Sedation Frisco](https://www.friscominimolars.com/oral-sedation): Safe oral sedation for anxious children and special needs dental care
- [First Baby Visits](https://www.friscominimolars.com/first-baby-visits): Gentle first dental visit experience for babies per AAPD guidelines

## Specialized Treatments

- [Frenectomy Services for Children – Safe and Effective Treatment](https://www.friscominimolars.com/frenectomy): Safe frenectomy procedure for tongue-tie and lip-tie treatment
- [Fracture Repair](https://www.friscominimolars.com/fracture-repair): Expert tooth fracture repair using composite bonding for children
- [White Crowns and Fillings](https://www.friscominimolars.com/white-crowns-and-fillings): Tooth-colored composite restorations and white crowns for children
- [Mouthguards](https://www.friscominimolars.com/mouthguards): Custom mouthguards for sports protection and dental injury prevention
- [Oral Appliances](https://www.friscominimolars.com/oral-appliances): Oral appliances including bands, loops, and palatal expanders for children
